title: Desk at golden hour
caption: The sunset lamp on, several screens and a cube within reach.
alt: A multi-screen desk lit by an orange sunset lamp, with a tablet, two laptops, a monitor, a mechanical keyboard, a Rubik's cube and photos on the wall.

title: Guitars by the window
caption: Morning light on the electric guitar.
alt: A white electric guitar leaning against a wall under a window, a black acoustic guitar body in the foreground and a camera tripod on the right.

title: Late-night desk
caption: A soldering station, a dev board and a draft of this portfolio.
alt: A desk at night with a soldering station, a microcontroller board, a laptop showing a website, a tablet with handwritten notes and a Rubik's cube.

title: Afternoon nap
caption: A neighbourhood cat that chose the warmest corner.
alt: A black and white cat curled up asleep against a stone pillar in late sunlight.

title: Mountains from above
caption: Snow-streaked ridges seen from a plane window.
alt: Aerial view of dark mountain ridges with patches of snow under a pale blue sky.

title: Winter tree and mistletoe
caption: Bare branches against a grey sky, with mistletoe clusters on the right.
alt: Looking up into a leafless tree with dark, frosted branches against a pale sky; round mistletoe clusters hang in a neighbouring tree.

title: What I brought home
caption: Lanyards, gadgets and stickers from career fairs and tech events, plus a punched card.
alt: A flat lay on a wooden table: lanyards, a water bottle, pens, USB drives, a ruler, a watch, sticky notes and a FORTRAN punched card.

title: Renwick Gallery at night
caption: The Smithsonian's Renwick Gallery in Washington, D.C., during the "State Fairs" exhibition.
alt: The red-brick facade of the Renwick Gallery at night with two blue "State Fairs" banners and a giant painted cowboy boot sculpture.

title: After closing time
caption: An empty burger bar, lit by neon and pendant lamps.
alt: An empty fast-food restaurant at night with dark tables, booth seating, a lowered shutter and warm wood panelling.

title: Autumn walk to campus
caption: Maple leaves covering the path on a bright October day.
alt: A wide footpath and cycle lane covered in fallen maple leaves beside a stone university building, with autumn trees and a clear blue sky.

title: Campus and tram
caption: A tram passing in front of the university on a summer afternoon.
alt: A blue and pink advertising tram passing in front of two symmetrical stone university buildings joined by a modern bridge, under a blue sky.

title: First snow
caption: The city goes quiet under the first proper snowfall.
alt: Elevated view of a snowy neighbourhood: white rooftops, snow-covered trees, a road with cars and apartment blocks in grey haze.

title: Market Square fountain
caption: The glass fountain in Wrocław's Market Square under a storm sky.
alt: Tall green glass panels of a fountain in the foreground, with colourful old townhouses and people on the square behind under dark clouds.

title: Office block at dusk
caption: Last light on the clouds while the street falls into shadow.
alt: A grid-windowed office building at dusk under a blue sky with warm clouds, framed by tree branches and a street lamp.

title: Red sky over Wrocław
caption: The whole sky caught fire for about ten minutes.
alt: A deep red and orange cloud-filled sky over a dark city silhouette, with the sun just touching the horizon.

title: Rippled sky
caption: Altocumulus clouds spreading over the rooftops.
alt: A sky filled with rippled white clouds in a diagonal band against deep blue, above the flat roofs of apartment blocks.

title: Summer sunset
caption: The sun setting into the skyline, a plane trail overhead.
alt: An orange and blue gradient sunset over a city skyline, with a red sun on the horizon, a domed hall with a tall spire and a contrail in the sky.

title: Towers in the fog
caption: A winter morning when the tower blocks disappeared into the fog.
alt: Two tall residential towers fading into purple fog above a wet intersection with cars, streetlights and a shopping centre.

title: Winter sunrise
caption: A red sun rising through haze over the rooftops.
alt: A red sun on the horizon over a hazy city skyline, with an orange sky above and dark treetops below.
